archetype_description: Tactile Editorial Planner — combines Swiss typographic grid structure with warm organic botanical warmth (warm cream stone base, deep slate pine text, amber sunrise and twilight violet highlights) for a serene, mindful day planning experience.

typography.pairing_rules: Use Outfit Variable (weight 600-800, tracking-tight) for bold calendar dates, morning/evening ritual titles, and widget headers. Use DM Sans (weight 400-500) for readable agenda items, notes, recipe slots, and shopping list items. Use IBM Plex Mono for timestamps (e.g., '08:30 AM'), temperature readings ('72°F / 22°C'), habit streaks ('🔥 14 days'), and counter ratios ('18/20').

entry_surfaces./: Modular day dashboard grid — hero morning weather card top left, quick action launcher top right, today's time-blocked appointments left column, habits checklist & counter trackers center, and meals + shopping peek right column.
entry_surfaces./morning: Morning Overview briefing ritual — high-impact weather hero panel with hourly forecast, today's schedule agenda timeline, habit intentions, and breakfast/lunch preview.
entry_surfaces./evening: Evening Review reflective sanctuary — daily habit completion streak scorecard, reflection notes, and tomorrow's preview (appointments, tomorrow's meals, weather, and reminders).
entry_surfaces./calendar: Interactive Monthly & Weekly calendar view with day-drilldown drawer showing appointments, habit heat-grid, and meal allocations.
entry_surfaces./habits: Habit command center with toggle views for Streak Mode (daily flame counters) vs Monthly Counter Mode (progress rings & monthly targets).
entry_surfaces./planner: Meal plans (breakfast/lunch/dinner/snack) with one-click 'Send ingredients to Shopping List' and interactive grocery list drawer.
entry_surfaces./settings: Preferences center — default home city selection, geolocation auto-detect switch, weather units (°C/°F), and light/dark theme switch.

visual_enhancers.glassmorphism: Used for sticky top navigation bar (backdrop-blur-md bg-white/80 dark:bg-[#121715]/80 border-b border-[#E8E4DA] dark:border-[#2D3732]).
visual_enhancers.widget_aesthetics: Tactile card styling with subtle 1px border (`border-[#E8E4DA] dark:border-[#2D3732]`), warm ambient drop shadows (`shadow-sm hover:shadow-md transition-shadow duration-200`), and rounded-2xl radii.
visual_enhancers.ambient_gradients: Warm morning glow (`bg-gradient-to-br from-amber-500/10 via-orange-500/5 to-transparent`) on Morning Overview; twilight glow (`bg-gradient-to-br from-indigo-500/10 via-purple-500/5 to-transparent`) on Evening Review.
visual_enhancers.pwa_home_widget: A dedicated 'Compact Widget View' toggle mode on the home screen designed specifically for quick mobile glances and tablet dashboard stands.

interactions: Habit check-off: spring scale-up micro-bounce (scale: [1, 1.15, 1]) + subtle celebratory burst on target completion
Page transitions: smooth fade and subtle upward slide (opacity 0 to 1, y: 12 to 0, ease: 'easeOut', duration: 0.25)
Shopping list check-off: strikethrough animation with smooth opacity fade to 0.5
Date slider: horizontal momentum drag and tap transitions for quick day-switching

accessibility.contrast_standard: All text tokens meet APCA and WCAG 2.1 AA (4.5:1 for standard text, 3:1 for large headers).
accessibility.keyboard_navigation: Full keyboard accessibility across all modals, calendar cell selections, habit check boxes, and shopping list items with distinct focus-visible rings (focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-teal-600).
accessibility.reduced_motion: All motion transitions respect `prefers-reduced-motion: reduce` by degrading to instant opacity switches.

testing_attributes.rule: Every interactive button, modal trigger, tab, habit checkbox, appointment item, meal slot, and theme toggle MUST have unambiguous data-testid attributes.

instructions_to_main_agent: 1. Read this guidelines file to adhere to the warm organic productivity archetype and typography pairing.
2. Ensure index.css uses Outfit Variable for headings and DM Sans Variable for body.

3. Build full FastAPI endpoints in backend for appointments, habits (streak and monthly counter modes), reminders, meals, shopping list, settings (location, theme, units), and Open-Meteo weather caching.

4. Implement the Home Widget dashboard, Morning Overview page (/morning), Evening Review page (/evening), Calendar view (/calendar), Habits page (/habits), Meal & Shopping Planner (/planner), and Settings page (/settings).
5. Integrate Open-Meteo API for real-time weather and forecasts with browser geolocation fallback + home city fallback.
6. Ensure dark mode toggle seamlessly updates the html.dark class and persists user preference.
7. Add realistic seed data so the user opens a populated, lively day planner ready for immediate demonstration.
